objective: Diagnostico runtime minimo: leer exclusivamente el resultado local del Worker para el job P5 runtime E2E fallido y persistir evidencia sanitizada del stdout de sus checks para identificar si el fallo fue configuracion TEST_BASE_URL, credenciales de prueba, conectividad/backend, RBAC CENTRO_CONTROL_VER/sync_monitor_VER o endpoint especifico. No ejecutar de nuevo el E2E, no tocar codigo funcional, no tocar Worker, no tocar Produccion.

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

TARGET = 'CENTRO-CONTROL-SYNC-MONITOR-GATE2-P5-RUNTIME-E2E-HTTP-RBAC-NOTIFICATIONS-20260909T2301Z'
STATE = Path('/app/.git/universal-worker-queue')
OUT = Path('tests/p5_runtime_local_result_diagnostic_evidence.json')

def _redact(text):
    value = str(text or '')
    value = re.sub(r'(?i)Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+', 'Bearer [REDACTED]', value)
    value = re.sub(r'(?i)(password|passwd|token|secret|authorization)([\s\"':=]+)([^\s,}\]\"]+)', r'\1\2[REDACTED]', value)
    return value

def _load(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

def test_capture_failed_runtime_e2e_stdout():
    candidates = []
    for bucket in ('results', 'done', 'rejected', 'processing', 'pending'):
        path = STATE / bucket / f'{TARGET}.json'
        if path.is_file():
            payload = _load(path)
            checks = []
            for check in payload.get('checks') or []:
                checks.append({
                    'type': check.get('type'),
                    'status': check.get('status'),
                    'returncode': check.get('returncode'),
                    'output': _redact(check.get('output'))[-12000:],
                })
            candidates.append({
                'bucket': bucket,
                'job_id': payload.get('job_id'),
                'status': payload.get('status'),
                'blockers': payload.get('blockers'),
                'checks': checks,
            })
    assert candidates, 'LOCAL_RESULT_NOT_FOUND'
    combined = '\n'.join(c.get('output','') for item in candidates for c in item.get('checks', []))
    classification = {
        'test_base_url_missing': 'RUNTIME_E2E_CONFIG_MISSING: TEST_BASE_URL/REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL' in combined,
        'test_credentials_missing': 'RUNTIME_E2E_CONFIG_MISSING: TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD' in combined,
        'login_failed': 'RUNTIME_LOGIN_FAILED' in combined,
        'backend_connectivity_failure': any(x in combined for x in ['ConnectionError', 'Connection refused', 'ConnectTimeout', 'ReadTimeout', 'NameResolutionError']),
        'centro_rbac_or_runtime_failed': 'CENTRO_RBAC_OR_RUNTIME_FAILED' in combined,
        'sync_rbac_or_runtime_failed': 'SYNC_RBAC_OR_RUNTIME_FAILED' in combined,
        'specific_centro_endpoint_failed': 'CENTRO_ENDPOINT_FAILED' in combined,
        'notification_config_failed': 'NOTIFICATION_CONFIG_FAILED' in combined,
    }
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps({
        'schema':'edarsahub.p5-runtime-local-diagnostic.v1',
        'target_job':TARGET,
        'production_touched':False,
        'classification':classification,
        'local_results':candidates,
    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    assert any(c.get('type') == 'pytest' and c.get('status') == 'FAIL' for item in candidates for c in item.get('checks', [])), 'FAILED_PYTEST_OUTPUT_NOT_FOUND'
